proposed_from.topic: Revival of banked downgraded parent stat_dp_cate_minimax_v1_holder_central_dp. Determine the incremental central-private minimax price for pointwise CATE on the exact-uniform coupled-nuisance Holder class with q=alpha+beta<gamma, leaving the separate nonprivate risk R_n^NP symbolic. Prove R_n^DP equivalent to max{R_n^NP,rho_n^priv} with an explicit phase diagram, one total private higher-order local estimator with complete all-dataset sensitivity accounting, and a matching positive-design fuzzy causal converse beyond the parent's two-point-TV barrier. Independently verify the presolved candidate rho_n^priv=max{(n epsilon_n)^(-gamma/(gamma+d)),(n^2 epsilon_n)^(-1/(1+d/gamma+d/q))}; do not restore the parent's unsupported (n epsilon)^(-q/(q+d)) formula. Do not duplicate or assume queued stat_cate_uniform_sparse_component_converse, which concerns only R_n^NP. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: A fixed-uniform-design projection identity makes local R-moment bias the product of alpha- and beta-projection errors plus gamma-localization bias. Binomial-normalized within-cell pair averages have exact expectation and claimed replacement sensitivity C/(n^2 h^d ell^d), avoiding nuisance pilots and occupancy logarithms. A same-class smooth fuzzy family has singleton cancellation; component maximal couplings and a spanning-tree sum claim Hamming cost C ab n^2 h^d ell^d, leading with adjacent-output DP telescoping to rho_priv=max{(n epsilon)^(-gamma/(gamma+d)),(n^2 epsilon)^(-1/(1+d/gamma+d/(alpha+beta)))}. The d=1, alpha=beta=1/8, gamma=1, epsilon=n^(-2/5) specialization gives matching n^(-4/15) upper and lower scales. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Below the nuisance elbow when privacy is inactive, replace the known nonprivate upper benchmark by symbolic R_n^NP using an independently verified comparator or a new privacy-transfer lemma; the queued nonprivate result is not assumed. EARLY KILL TEST: Verify the complete d=1 pair-release sensitivity and component-Hamming calculation at h proportional to n^(-4/15), ell proportional to n^(-16/15); stop on a surviving singleton, false factorization, or normalization bias. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/stat_dp_cate_uniform_design_nuisance_privacy_frontier.md.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: On the deliberately narrower known exact-uniform class, the field-level kernel introduces an exact binomial-normalized local pair query within one \(p^2+3p\)-coordinate release with all-dataset sensitivity \(C/(n^2h^d\ell^d)\), a positive exact-uniform fuzzy CATE family with shared-prior Hamming cost \(Cabn^2h^d\ell^d\), and the resulting privacy term \((n^2\epsilon_n)^{-1/(1+d/\gamma+d/(\alpha+\beta))}\). It does not claim to sharpen the published nonprivate rate, extend the result to bounded-density designs, or improve general private testing inequalities.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize the incremental pure-central-private minimax price as \(\max\{r_G,r_F\}\) on the exact-uniform coupled-nuisance Hölder class, leaving \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\) symbolic.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the nonprivate localized U-statistic and Hellinger fuzzy comparison by an all-dataset private joint release and an expected-Hamming coupling of shared-prior mixtures.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for central-private pointwise CATE Hölder minimax rates and private higher-order CATE estimators found no paper occupying this target-method pair.

seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Kennedy et al. plus private regression rates because CATE is just a regression function.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nuisance-product branch depends on a quadratic local correction and a composite-mixture transport cost absent from both comparators.
seed_details.burned_reason: The sole proposal angle was exhaustively repaired and reviewed; closing the remaining regime requires a new theorem outside the fixed topic's permitted dependencies.

seed_details.anchor: chaudhuri2024dpu, local Hájek projection algorithm and discussion
seed_details.kernel: Construct an exactly unbiased binomial-normalized local pair release with global sensitivity \(C/(n^2h^d\ell^d)\) and derive its CATE risk envelope.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Use known cell occupancy probability rather than thresholded empirical Hájek projections to normalize each cell block.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for binomial-normalized private local U-statistics and occupancy-normalized private CATE corrections found no matching construction.
seed_details.red_team: False because replacing one observation changes order \(n\) pairs.
seed_details.rebuttal: The statistic averages inside each occupied cell before aggregating cells; one replacement changes at most two bounded cell averages, and the known \(p_2\) factor restores exact expectation.
seed_details.decision: kept among the top three and incorporated as the upper half

seed_details.kernel: Build a positive exact-uniform smooth fuzzy CATE family with singleton cancellation and Hamming transport \(Cabn^2h^d\ell^d\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a two-point product total-variation calculation by conditional component factorization, maximal couplings, and a complete spanning-tree sum.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining fuzzy CATE hypotheses with central-private Hamming transport found only general reductions, not a causal construction.
adjacent_threads: lalanne2023statisticalcomplexity: transport formulation for private tests
seed_details.red_team: Singleton cancellation cannot control a shared-prior product mixture.
seed_details.rebuttal: It does not do so alone; repeated-sign observations form components whose full mixed-law variation is summed over all component sizes.
seed_details.decision: kept among the top three and incorporated as the converse half

seed_details.kernel: Derive a stability interface converting a nonprivate pointwise-CATE oracle risk into private risk \(\max\{R_n^{\mathrm{NP}},\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\}\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Strengthen the pseudo-outcome oracle decomposition from prediction error control to bounded replacement influence for every training and final-stage record.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found private CATE composition and model-agnostic private ATE work, but no risk-only pointwise-CATE transfer theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Apply the Laplace mechanism to any near-minimax estimator.
seed_details.rebuttal: Risk gives no global or smooth sensitivity bound; the missing stability certificate is substantive.
seed_details.decision: integrated into the selected full-frontier seed as its mandatory open-ended question

seed_details.kernel: Seek a privacy-adjusted semiparametric efficiency bound for a shrinking-bandwidth CATE projection.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a fixed pathwise differentiable target by a triangular local functional and derive the private tangent experiment.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches located private efficiency work for regular parameters but no stable efficiency bound for point evaluation over a Hölder class.
seed_details.red_team: There is no fixed regular estimand, so the efficiency bound is an artifact of the chosen bandwidth.
seed_details.rebuttal: A triangular experiment could be defined, but its answer would be less intrinsic than the minimax modulus.

seed_details.kernel: Derive the non-Gaussian limit law of the stabilized local CATE estimator at the boundary where sampling and Laplace noise are commensurate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After the Hájek decomposition, retain rather than dominate the privacy noise and prove joint convergence of the local U-statistic and Laplace term.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for private CATE transition limit laws found practical interval procedures but no local Hölder result.
seed_details.red_team: The limit is merely a convolution with known Laplace noise.
seed_details.rebuttal: Random occupancy and a shrinking degenerate pair term make joint convergence nontrivial, but the result does not settle the minimax target.
seed_details.decision: dropped in favor of the rate frontier

seed_details.anchor: niu2022dpcate, main composition theorem and conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Translate a private CATE release into a treatment-policy regret frontier under a Hölder decision boundary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pointwise loss by a margin-weighted welfare loss and optimize a private policy over a class.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found differentially private prediction and empirical welfare tools but no comparator tied to this exact local CATE class.
seed_details.red_team: A single pointwise CATE target does not define a policy-learning problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: A new global margin class would repair it, but that materially changes the accepted topic.

seed_details.anchor: niu2022dpcate, conclusion calling for theoretical privacy-accuracy characterization
seed_details.kernel: Construct a finite-sample private symmetry-inversion interval for pointwise CATE.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the asymptotic CATE learner by an exchangeability orbit compatible with treatment assignment and privacy noise.
seed_details.destination_search: The named search obstruction is that observational CATE identification supplies no finite permutation group preserving the missing potential outcomes at \(x_0\).
seed_details.red_team: Conditional exchangeability is not the finite-sample outcome symmetry required by conformal inversion.
seed_details.rebuttal: No credible repair remains within the exact-uniform observational model.

seed_details.kernel: Prove that nonprivate risk alone is neither necessary nor sufficient for private transfer by constructing equally accurate estimators with different stability moduli.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Augment a near-minimax estimator by a rare, high-sensitivity encoding that preserves risk but destroys black-box privatizability.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for black-box minimax-risk privacy transfer located stability-based mechanisms but no iff result for pointwise CATE.
seed_details.red_team: The pathological encoding only refutes an overly broad theorem and has no positive estimator consequence.
seed_details.rebuttal: It clarifies the logical bottleneck, but consumer value is lower than directly building the stability interface.

seed_details.kernel: Calibrate a pure-private Cauchy release of the local CATE pair correction through a smooth occupancy sensitivity envelope.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace global pair sensitivity by the maximum exponentially damped local sensitivity over nearby occupancy profiles.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found smooth-sensitivity estimators and private U-statistics, but no localized CATE application.
seed_details.red_team: Heavy-tailed pure-private noise loses the desired absolute-risk rate, and exact uniformity already gives a deterministic better envelope.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the present target, so the seed is dominated.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected seed combines three previously separate theorem threads. Kennedy et al. (2024), Theorems 1--2 and Sections 3--5, settle the nonprivate CATE rate on density-qualified classes and provide the localized higher-order and fuzzy architectures; their exact lower witness uses a changing support, so it does not identify \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\) on the fixed exact-uniform class. Chaudhuri et al. (2024), the local Hájek projection algorithm and discussion, establish that black-box private U-statistic releases can lose degeneracy; they do not exploit known binomial cell-occupancy probabilities or causal projection identities. Acharya et al. (2021), Theorems 1 and 3, and Lalanne et al. (2023) reduce private testing to expected Hamming transport; neither constructs a smooth causal shared-prior coupling. Cai et al. (2024), the pointwise-rate theorem and sensitivity proof, settle ordinary private nonparametric regression in a distributed model and calibrate only \(r_G\). Niu et al. (2022), the main privacy theorem and conclusion, cover modular CATE algorithms but explicitly leave the theoretical utility trade-off open. Kennedy (2023), Theorems 1--3, keeps an oracle regression term modular, but its risk inequality lacks a privacy stability certificate. Nissim et al. (2007) rules out substituting typical local occupancy for worst-case sensitivity without a smooth envelope. Searches through September 2026 found later private ATE, private CATE calibration, and smooth private testing papers, but none with both the exact-uniform higher-order CATE release and the positive fuzzy Hamming converse. Thus no closer paper subsumes the kernel.
